# External synthetic dataset schema

Source: [Insurance Claim Fraud Detection Dataset Generator](https://github.com/MobeenFatimaa/Insurance-Claim-Fraud-Detection-Dataset-Generator), commit `2551a1c77275464906f65daabcd6d208b7d33c32` (inspected 2026-10-19).

- Licence: Apache License 2.0.
- Provenance: programmatically generated synthetic motor-insurance records; the publisher says it contains no real customers or claims.
- Generator size/seed: 100,000 rows, seed 42.
- Shape: 62 columns in the checked-in generator (the README inconsistently says both 61 and 62; the generator's explicit output list is authoritative).
- Generated date range: incidents from 2021-01-01 through 2025-12-31.
- Null policy: every generated field is populated; the adapter still measures and reports nulls from the actual CSV before a run.
- Label warning: `fraudulent` and `fraud_risk_score` are generated by the source's own formula. They are dropped and never treated as Claims Engine ground truth.

## Columns

Identifiers: `claim_id`, `policy_id`, `customer_id`.

Customer: `customer_name`, `age`, `gender`, `marital_status`, `occupation`, `annual_income`, `education_level`, `credit_score`, `years_with_company`, `previous_claims`.

Claim/dates: `claim_date`, `incident_date`, `claim_status`, `claim_amount`, `approved_amount`, `deductible`, `claim_duration_days`, `payout_amount`.

Policy: `policy_type`, `policy_start_date`, `policy_duration_years`, `premium_amount`, `coverage_amount`, `deductible_plan`, `payment_method`, `policy_active`.

Incident: `incident_type`, `accident_severity`, `incident_location`, `weather_condition`, `police_report`, `witnesses`, `injuries`, `hospital_visit`, `property_damage`.

Vehicle: `vehicle_damage`, `vehicle_make`, `vehicle_model`, `vehicle_year`, `vehicle_age`, `mileage`, `vehicle_value`, `ownership_type`.

Risk indicators/costs: `suspicious_documents`, `claim_submitted_at_night`, `multiple_claims_last_year`, `delayed_reporting`, `inconsistent_statements`, `gps_location_match`, `repair_shop_verified`, `identity_verified`, `claim_history_risk`, `fraud_risk_score`, `repair_cost`, `medical_cost`, `towing_cost`, `rental_vehicle_cost`, `total_loss`, `fraudulent`.

## Mapping to this Claims API

| Source | Claims request | Rule |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `claim_id` | `Idempotency-Key` | Prefix with `external-`; not included in the body |
| seeded benchmark patient | `patient_id` | Deterministic synthetic fill |
| seeded AHCIP plan | `plan_id` | Deterministic synthetic fill |
| constant `AB` | `province` | Synthetic fill |
| hash of `policy_id` | `provider_billing_number` | Stable six digits |
| `incident_date` | `service_date` | Ordinal offset modulo 60 from the run anchor, keeping it in the active seeded policy window |
| hash of `incident_type` | `lines[0].service_code` | Stable choice from known AHCIP codes |
| hash of `claim_id` | `lines[0].diagnosis_code` | Stable choice from known ICD-10-CA codes |
| `claim_amount` | `lines[0].amount` | Decimal, rounded to two places and clamped to API bounds |
| constant `1` | `lines[0].units` | Synthetic fill |
| all other columns | dropped | Recorded in per-row adapter metadata |

The mapping coverage is 5/62 source fields (8.1%) because the source is motor-insurance data while this API is Canadian health claims. Seven target fields are synthetic fills. Dataset runs report these facts and assert robustness/integrity only—not business-rule or fraud-label correctness.
